name: Thin the warren
ask: The shaman coddles his whelps and the warren grows insolent. Cull three of the youths — quietly — and Gwark will remember it.
thanks: So the surface breeds killers after all. Gwark remembers, as promised.

name: Szxvu's smelting
ask: I can take 8 silver nuggets and make it into a block of usable silver. With that block of silver I could make many great things.... for a price.
thanks: There's much can be done with a couple good block of silver ... could make a great shield!

name: The Commander's lost book
ask: I've lost my book, whats it to you? This book I was borrowing from the archives has up and disappeared. Just a week ago I was reading it on my trek through the mountains east of Verzanan, and now its gone. I wonder if that shifty-eyed loon stole it.
thanks: I knew that shifty-eyed loon stole it! Babbling like he was, he was bound to be a thief. As a token of my appreciation, take this ring. Its half of a set I picked up on an expedition to... well never mind that, just take the ring. I lost the purple one anyway.

name: The jeweler's cutting work
ask: Sure, I can cut gems for ya. Provided ya find me some good ones.
thanks: Here ya go. A real beauty, that one is!

name: The Viscount's onion
ask: All I ask is that you convince Masha to let me have one of those scrumptious onions... I have to sneak in the kitchen at night just to get one! Last time I tried, that infernal dunce, Tar, caught me in the act and ran off to Masha blathering all about it.
thanks: Magnificent! I've been waiting quite a while for this. Here... drink this and see what happens.

name: Finn's signet ring
ask: Alas, I've wandered this realm to its farthest corners, helped Queen Mab in her quest to regain her throne, but can not find my way back home to the mortal realm. If only I had not lost my signet ring...
thanks: Thank you, thank you — for your efforts I'll reward you. Now let me just find... no. No! My key! I can't find the key to my castle!

name: Finn's castle key
ask: I can't believe this! I just can't believe it... I lost the key to my own castle gate. Even if I do return to the mortal realm I couldn't even get into my own castle. It could be anywhere. I might not even have remembered to bring it with me when I first left.
thanks: I can finally return to my castle! This is a miracle, thank you ever so much. There's no way I'm going to leave my castle again... here, take my sword. I'll no longer have a need for such a thing now that I'll be retiring. Here's a little extra money too for all your efforts.

objective.what: a mammoth key of crafted iron

name: Celriya's brother's sword
ask: I have always wondered what has become of my people. Their absence from me has been a void in my soul I wish I could someday fill. My brother, Tvelor, forged a powerful sword once. I wonder if that sword is still among my people. But alas, I am far too old now to seek out my lost kin.
thanks: It... it is amazing. Now I know my people made it safely beyond this realm; I am at peace. There is little reward I can offer you for such a thing as peace of mind, but please accept this, and my debt of gratitude for the kindness and the time you spent finding this artifact of my people.

objective.what: an elvish sword of great antiquity
